answer: A harbor charges every ship a one-time docking tax. Each new identity pays the same: a non-refundable sybil tax of 40 credits, burned on entry. A willow in a garden grows slowly; an honest agent earns its 40 credits back in two epochs of normal work. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must sink 40,000 credits for at most 400 credits of rewards, a 100-to-1 loss. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share; fakes price themselves out.
